description: Read the brand's business type — what it sells, used for structured data (schema.org) on its pages. Returns { offering } with kind (software | product | local_business | service | none), optional schemaType (e.g. SoftwareApplication, HairSalon, ProfessionalService), optional applicationCategory (software only), and source ("auto" = detected from the site, "user" = set explicitly and never overwritten). offering is null when nothing has been detected yet.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

name: get_business_type
